scope: National inland-fisheries microdata access and reuse screen; separate from the public PSA OpenSTAT aggregate table

sources.title: Quarterly Inland Fisheries Survey 2021
sources.provider: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), PSADA Data Archive
sources.dataFileDescription: QIFS2021Q1 Sample Data; catalog dictionary reports 164 cases and 142 variables.
sources.accessStatus: PSA metadata and collection use terms were opened. The official data-dictionary result was reviewed as indexed text; the page itself returned a cache miss. No data file was downloaded and no terms were accepted.
sources.reuseStatus: The catalog terms authorize use only for the client/data user, forbid copying or redistribution of data or parts, and limit use to statistical/scientific research and aggregated reporting. No permission to redistribute microdata or use its row-level content in a public app was identified.

findings.surveyPurpose: PSA describes QIFS as collecting inland fish catch by species and producing quarterly volume/value estimates at province, regional and national levels. Its collection page includes lakes, rivers, dams, marshes, swamps, irrigation canals and creeks in the inland-water definition.

geographicAndVariableMetadata.catalogGeographicUnit: The 2021 study metadata says province is the lowest geographic level of disaggregation.
dataDictionaryFieldsReported: monthly catch volume and price fields
geographicAndVariableMetadata.resolutionIssue: The dictionary exposes municipality/barangay and fishing-ground fields while the study-level metadata states province is the lowest geographic disaggregation. The relationship between sample microdata fields, released anonymization, and publishable statistical geography is unresolved; a FISH_GROUND text field alone does not establish a verified waterbody or coordinate.

privacyAndUseTerms.versionNote: The catalog labels Version 1.0 as edited for preliminary computation and anonymized.
privacyAndUseTerms.instrumentNote: The study metadata says the questionnaire records names of the household head and respondent and uses household-level catch reporting. The reviewed variable dictionary also lists those name fields.
terms: Authorization is granted only to the client/data user.
Copying, reproducing, distributing, selling or lending the data or any parts is prohibited except as authorized by PSA.
Use is limited to statistical/scientific research and reporting aggregated information.
No attempt may be made to re-identify a person, establishment or sampling unit or link datasets to do so.
privacyAndUseTerms.decision: The apparent anonymization note does not override the explicit access/use terms. Do not download, accept terms, publish, or ingest row-level QIFS microdata for Bangwit without separately confirmed PSA authorization and a privacy-safe, appropriately aggregated product.

findings.separationFromOpenstat: This PSADA household-survey catalog is not the same artifact or license as the PSA OpenSTAT province/region aggregate table. The existing OpenSTAT review remains the usable discovery layer; it does not resolve specific rivers, lakes, stations, or exact capture locations.

nextAction: If a waterbody-safe QIFS output would materially help the inland inventory, ask PSA whether it can provide an authorized aggregated result with suppressed small cells, explicit waterbody/reporting geography, survey year, taxonomic category definitions, and redistribution terms. Do not send a request or accept microdata terms without the project owner's separate choice.
